About Cancun

Cancun fronts the Caribbean with powder-white sand and turquoise water, and serves as the gateway to the Riviera Maya's cenotes and Maya ruins.

Best time to visit Cancun

The sweet spot is generally Dec–Apr (dry season) — and the cheapest fares often land just outside peak season.

Top things to do in Cancun

  • Beach days along the Hotel Zone
  • Snorkel the Mesoamerican Reef
  • Swim in a jungle cenote
  • Explore Tulum or Chichen Itza
  • Ferry to Isla Mujeres

Good to know

Resort areas generally safe. Language: Spanish. Visa for US passports: Visa-free, up to 180 days.
